name: ClinePass
notes: Subscription at $9.99/month with no per-token prices; each model carries the reference price shown on the ClinePass page, so Cost is what the request would cost pay-as-you-go. Limits apply over a 5-hour rolling window, a calendar week and a calendar month; their absolute sizes are not published, and no quota endpoint is documented, so there is no quota reader. Not flagged for Terms Risk (ADR 0099): ClinePass documents its endpoint for third-party tools, but the Cline Terms of Service (https://cline.bot/tos, last modified 2025-09-25) say in §1.2(d) "you will not share your password(s) and/or any other authentication credentials with anyone else", forbid in §2.2(4) to "buy, sell or transfer API keys without our prior written consent" and in §2.2(5) to resell or distribute the Service, and say in §7.3(c)(v) "you will not allow or enable anyone else to use your Subscription", so sharing the gateway with other people breaches them. The API wraps non-streaming answers in {success, data} unless the request carries X-Response-Format: openai, so the fixedHeaders quirk sends it on every request; streaming is unaffected. No exhaustedErrorCodes: the error for a used-up pass limit is undocumented. A 402 insufficient_credits answer means a model outside the pass or an empty pay-as-you-go Cline Credits balance, not an exhausted pass, so it is deliberately left out. GET /api/v1/models lists no cline-pass/ ids; the shipped list is the docs list, checked live with a ClinePass key on 2026-11-22. Not shipped: cline-pass/muse-spark-1.3-contributor, because the Contributor tier trains on prompts, which conflicts with ADR 0004; cline-pass/minimax-m3, cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-pro and cline-pass/mimo-v2.6-flash, which the docs list but which answered "model not found" on 2026-11-22; cline-pass/qwen3.7-max and cline-pass/qwen3.7-plus, which answered 402 insufficient_credits, i.e. are billed to Cline Credits rather than the pass.

upstreamModels.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
upstreamModels.notes: Confirmed with a ClinePass key on 2026-11-22; routed to private/cw-deepseek-v41-flash-1017. Name, release date, capabilities, context size and max output are copied from the deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 Upstream Model in the alibaba-token-plan Catalog file; prices are the reference prices on the ClinePass page, what the request would cost pay-as-you-go. The page lists a peak and an off-peak price; this is the peak price, so Cost is never understated. Cache write is not published and is set to the input price.
